newsitem.title: CHILE: Swedish King in Chile for official visit.
newsitem.headline: Swedish King in Chile for official visit.

text.p: Sweden's King Carl Gustav and Queen Silvia arrived in Chile on Sunday for a five-day official visit aimed at strengthening bilateral trade ties.
The royal couple, who are accompanied by a delegation of leading businessmen, will have talks with President Eduardo Frei on Monday.
Sweden hopes that the visit will give a boost to bilateral trade, which totalled just over $200 million in 1995, Swedish ambassador Madeleine Stroje-Wilkens said.

The visit also reflects the steady improvement in political links between the two countries since Chile's return to democracy in 1990 after 17 years of military rule under dictator General Augusto Pinochet.
Sweden was one of the staunchest opponents of the military regime and is home to around 35,000 Chileans, most of whom were political exiles.
The Swedish couple's visit will include a tour of Nobel-prize winning poet Pablo Neruda's seaside home near Santiago, which has been turned into a museum.
The royal couple will also visit Cerro Paranal in the northern Atacama Desert where scientists are building the world's largest telescope. They are scheduled to return to Sweden on Friday.
